only_strategy_change: At most one ATTACK per turn: require an owned triangle with one unit per corner, at least six own units and a target stack of at least four enemies. Choose the largest reachable stack. Deduct the three units, cleared enemy stack and spent triangle before the v3 planner.

maps.context: Both sets have been used before; neither is a fresh holdout.

match_protocol: Rerun v3 and v6 interleaved on each identical map, seat and opponent; two seats; original fixed Lacoz and khoufou sources; 800 scheduled games total.
primary_metric: Game wins excluding technical outcomes; paired clean change clustered by map; report timeouts separately.
selection: Promote only if the paired runs support improvement without own command errors; preserve both outcomes.
tuning: Freeze before the measured runs. Correctness smoke tests may precede them; no tuning on their outcomes.
